title: aquilegia buergeriana f. pallidiflora
intro: Aquilegia buergeriana f. pallidiflora, commonly known as the pale-flowered eastern columbine, is a flowering plant species within the buttercup family. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in East Asian cultures, for its potential health benefits. The pale-flowered eastern columbine has been reported to possess health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
